script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Workplace
Theme: friendship

Begin screenplay.

FADE IN:

EXT. SUNNY SAN FRANCISCO STREET - DAY

A bustling street in San Francisco. PEOPLE of all walks of life move about.

INT. MINDSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES - RECEPTION AREA - DAY

RACHEL, a 30s-something woman, sits behind the reception desk. A young woman, JESS, enters.

JESS
(looking at Rachel)
Hi, Rachel. How's your day?

RACHEL
(smiling)
It's been better. How about yours?

JESS
(sighs)
The usual. Lots to do, not enough hours. How about we grab lunch together sometime?

RACHEL
(brightening)
I'd like that.

INT. MINDSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES - CONFERENCE ROOM - LATER

A group of EMPLOYEES sit around a large table. JESS sits next to MIKE, an older man with a kind smile. RACHEL joins them.

MIKE
(looking at Rachel)
So, Rachel, tell us about your latest project.

RACHEL
(nervously)
It's a new software for managing company data. It's more efficient and user-friendly than our current system.

JESS
That sounds great. I'd be happy to help you out if you need any assistance.

RACHEL
(grateful)
Thank you, Jess. That means a lot.

MIKE
(smiling)
Teamwork makes the dream work, right?

They all nod in agreement.

INT. MINDSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES - BREAK ROOM - LATER

Jess and Rachel sit on a couch, eating lunch.

JESS
So, tell me more about yourself. Where did you grow up?

RACHEL
I grew up in a small town in Oregon. It was quiet and peaceful. I came to San Francisco for college and never left.

JESS
That's cool. I grew up here. I've always loved this city.

They share a moment of connection.

INT. MINDSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES - OFFICE - LATER

Rachel is working late when she hears a knock on her door. It's Jess.

JESS
Hey, Rachel. I was just wondering if you needed any help with your project.

RACHEL
(grateful)
I really appreciate that, Jess. But I think I've got it under control.

JESS
(smiling)
Well, if you change your mind, just let me know.

RACHEL
(smiling back)
I will.

INT. MINDSPIRE TECHNOLOGIES - RECEPTION AREA - NIGHT

Rachel is still working when Jess appears.

JESS
Rachel, are you sure you're okay? You've been here for hours.

RACHEL
(sighs)
It's just one of those days. I can't seem to get everything done.

JESS
(sitting down next to Rachel)
Why don't you take a break? I can finish up what you've been working on.

RACHEL
(surprised)
Really?

JESS
Of course. That's what friends are for.

They share a warm smile.

FADE OUT.

THE END
